title: Probing Leakage Benchmark: Separating Model Knowledge from Probe Learning Capacity

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If probing results are systematically overstated, safety conclusions drawn from probing studies may be wrong. This is methodologically important but the chain to a specific safety action is indirect. It primarily informs how to interpret existing work rather than producing new safety insights.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probes on GPT-2-Small activations are a standard tutorial exercise. Training probes on random model activations as a baseline is trivially implementable. TransformerLens provides activation extraction. Three tasks are manageable. Very beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three tasks, two conditions each (real vs random model), one metric (accuracy difference). Clear deliverable as a comparison table. Linear probes train in seconds. Easily fits 30 hours with room for additional analysis.
